decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the artist of the album 'Out of the Box'. Document D1 (and associated card C0) explicitly states the album is the debut mini-album released by 'Jade Valerie'. Document D3 (and associated card C1) contains a Wikipedia snippet listing 'Taylor Swift' as the artist for an album titled 'Out of the Box' released on the same date (October 17, 2007). As the prompt instructs to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without inventing authority to resolve them, both names are retained. Candidates C2 (Tony James) and C3 (Vivian Bayubay) are rejected as they are identified as hosts of a Disney Channel show with the same name, not the album artist.
